message.content: {"caption":"A three-series line chart compares average input tokens, output tokens, and cost across three task levels.","description":"The line chart has task level 1, level 2, and level 3 on the x-axis. The left y-axis, labeled “Avg Input / Output,” runs from 0 to 120,000 with 20,000-unit ticks; the right y-axis, labeled “Avg Cost,” has ticks from 0.06 to 0.18 in increments of 0.02. The legend identifies blue circles and a line as Avg Input, green squares and a line as Avg Output, and pink triangles and a line as Avg Cost. All three series increase across the levels. Avg Input rises sharply, from about 26,000 to 48,000 and then to about 121,000 (the final point is slightly above the 120,000 tick). Avg Output rises more gradually, from about 4,000 to 7,000 and then to 10,000. Avg Cost rises from about 0.05 to 0.09 and then to 0.18. Values are estimated from the plotted marks; the chart does not print values beside the points.","figure_type":"chart","chart_values":[{"series":"Avg Input","category":"level 1","x":"level 1","value":26000,"value_status":"estimated"},{"series":"Avg Input","category":"level 2","x":"level 2","value":48000,"value_status":"estimated"},{"series":"Avg Input","category":"level 3","x":"level 3","value":121000,"value_status":"estimated"},{"series":"Avg Output","category":"level 1","x":"level 1","value":4000,"value_status":"estimated"},{"series":"Avg Output","category":"level 2","x":"level 2","value":7000,"value_status":"estimated"},{"series":"Avg Output","category":"level 3","x":"level 3","value":10000,"value_status":"estimated"},{"series":"Avg Cost","category":"level 1","x":"level 1","value":0.05,"value_status":"estimated"},{"series":"Avg Cost","category":"level 2","x":"level 2","value":0.09,"value_status":"estimated"},{"series":"Avg Cost","category":"level 3","x":"level 3","value":0.18,"value_status":"estimated"}]}
